_note: Starter transit cards from GAME_DESIGN section 5. Amounts are flat units or a percent of what the ship holds. delayDays: the ship stands still, supplies still burn. detourDays: the same plus the fuel the lost distance would have burned. PLACEHOLDER numbers (see docs/BALANCE.md). M4 adds Exploration and NativeContact cards: their effects act on the expedition (colonists = explorers, supplies = expedition supplies, delayDays = days standing still, revealRegion = one frontier region explored, nativeMood = natives calmer or angrier). Trigger terrain / native narrow when a card can come up. M7a adds 6 Transit, 6 Exploration and 3 NativeContact cards (30 in all); a NativeContact card may also name trigger.variant (a native variant id in planetfall.json).

events.title: Micrometeor storm
events.body: A dense cloud of debris lies across the route. The hull can take it, or we can go around.

choices.label: Push through
choices.preview: Hull damage, no delay.

choices.label: Detour
choices.preview: Extra days and extra fuel burned.

events.title: Illness outbreak
events.body: Fever is spreading through the passenger decks. The medical stores are limited.

choices.label: Use medical supplies
choices.preview: Medical supplies used, nobody lost.

choices.label: Quarantine
choices.preview: A few colonists lost, supplies untouched.

events.title: Engine fault
events.body: A coolant line has failed in the main drive. Engineers can fix it while we drift, or we can run degraded.

choices.label: Repair
choices.preview: Days lost, supplies keep burning.

choices.label: Limp on
choices.preview: Speed drops a level and some days are lost.

events.title: Derelict ship found
events.body: A dead vessel drifts off the route, its tanks possibly full. It could also be a trap.

choices.label: Salvage
choices.preview: Fuel gained, with a shown chance of a trap that hurts hull and colonists.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Stowaways
events.body: Twelve people are found hidden in the cargo hold. They are hungry and asking to stay.

choices.label: Take them
choices.preview: More colonists, fewer supplies.

choices.label: Leave at nearest colony
choices.preview: A short detour and extra fuel burned.

events.title: Strange signal
events.body: The long-range array picks up a repeating pulse from a nearby star.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.preview: A few days lost, a nearby planet is scanned.

choices.label: Stay on course
choices.preview: No delay, no cost.

events.title: Sealed vault
events.body: Behind a collapsed arch the team finds a vault that hums faintly. It may hold something useful, or be unsafe.

choices.label: Break it open
choices.preview: A new region is revealed, with a shown chance the vault collapses and explorers are lost.

choices.label: Seal and move on
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Strange lights
events.body: Pale lights drift over the next ridge at night. Nobody can say whether they are alive.

choices.label: Follow them
choices.preview: Days lost, and a new region is revealed.

choices.label: Hold position
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Spoiled stores
events.body: Damp has got into part of the stores. Some of it can be saved, if there is time.

choices.label: Sort the stores
choices.preview: Days lost and some supplies lost.

choices.label: Discard and go
choices.preview: More supplies lost, no delay.

events.title: Sinkhole
events.body: The ground gives way under the rear of the column. Several people are trapped below.

choices.label: Dig them out
choices.preview: Days lost, supplies spent on the rescue.

choices.label: Press on
choices.preview: Explorers are lost, no delay.

events.title: Fever in camp
events.body: Fever spreads through the camp after a night in the wet forest.

choices.label: Treat the sick
choices.preview: Medical supplies spent, nobody lost.

choices.label: Push on
choices.preview: A few explorers lost, supplies untouched.

events.title: Fresh spring
events.body: A clean spring runs beside the route, good for a long rest and for refilling the casks.

choices.label: Rest and refill
choices.preview: Days lost eating supplies, then supplies gained.

choices.label: Mark and move on
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Guides offered
events.body: Villagers meet the team at the edge of their fields. Several offer to guide us across their land.

choices.label: Accept guides
choices.preview: Days lost and supplies spent as thanks, a new region revealed.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Watchers on the ridge
events.body: Figures watch from the ridge and keep their distance. Their spears are lowered, for now.

choices.label: Offer gifts
choices.preview: Supplies spent, with a shown chance the natives grow calmer.

choices.label: Show strength
choices.preview: Free, with a chance the natives grow angrier that rises with the escort.

choices.label: Withdraw
choices.preview: Days lost, natives left as they are.

events.title: Warband in the pass
events.body: A warband blocks the pass. They have not attacked yet, and they have not stepped aside.

choices.label: Stand firm
choices.preview: Free, with a shown chance of a clash that costs explorers and falls with the escort.

choices.label: Parley
choices.preview: Supplies spent, with a shown chance the natives grow calmer.

choices.label: Retreat
choices.preview: Days lost, natives left as they are.

events.title: Solar flare
events.body: A flare is climbing the star's limb and the radiation alarm has sounded. Shelter costs time; running ahead of it risks the passenger decks.

choices.label: Shelter in the core
choices.preview: Days lost while the flare passes, nobody hurt.

choices.label: Run ahead
choices.preview: No delay, with a shown chance of hull damage and colonists lost.

events.title: Recycler failure
events.body: The water recycler has failed on the lower decks. Spare parts exist, but only by stripping other stores.

choices.label: Strip the stores
choices.preview: Supplies lost, nobody hurt.

choices.label: Ration water
choices.preview: Colonists lost to thirst and sickness, supplies kept.

choices.label: Repair slowly
choices.preview: Days lost while the line is rebuilt.

events.title: Unrest on the decks
events.body: Crowded decks and short tempers have led to a fight in the mess hall. The council asks for a ruling.

choices.label: Hold an assembly
choices.preview: Days lost, calm restored.

choices.label: Extra rations
choices.preview: Supplies spent to ease tempers.

choices.label: Tighten order
choices.preview: No delay, with a shown chance some colonists are lost.

events.title: Comet tail
events.body: A comet's tail crosses the route, thick with ice and dust. Scooping it could refill the water tanks.

choices.label: Scoop the ice
choices.preview: Supplies gained, with a shown chance the dust damages the hull.

choices.label: Keep clear
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Passing convoy
events.body: A freight convoy hails the ship on the long-range band. Their holds are full and they are willing to trade.

choices.label: Buy fuel
choices.preview: Supplies spent, fuel gained.

choices.label: Buy provisions
choices.preview: Fuel spent, supplies gained.

choices.label: Decline
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Navigation drift
events.body: The star tracker disagrees with the inertial log, and the error grows by the hour.

choices.label: Recalibrate
choices.preview: Days lost while the instruments are checked.

choices.label: Steer by eye
choices.preview: No delay, with a shown chance the error costs days.

events.title: Whiteout
events.body: A whiteout closes over the column. Visibility drops to arm's length and the cold seeps through the tents.

choices.label: Dig in and wait
choices.preview: Days lost, supplies burned for warmth.

choices.label: March blind
choices.preview: No delay, with a shown chance explorers are lost in the snow.

events.title: Unstable rim
events.body: The crater rim crumbles under the column. Packs are sliding toward the floor of the bowl.

choices.label: Recover the gear
choices.preview: Days lost and a few explorers may be lost.

choices.label: Abandon it
choices.preview: Supplies lost, no delay.

events.title: Carved stair
events.body: A stair cut into the rock leads down past the survey line. The steps are worn smooth and the air below is dry.

choices.label: Descend
choices.preview: Days lost and a new region revealed, with a shown chance explorers fall.

choices.label: Send a rope team
choices.preview: Supplies spent, a new region revealed, no risk.

choices.label: Mark and move on
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Fruiting grove
events.body: Heavy fruit hangs over the trail. Nobody knows what is safe to eat, and the team is hungry.

choices.label: Gather and eat
choices.preview: Supplies gained, with a shown chance explorers fall sick.

choices.label: Test first
choices.preview: Days lost, fewer supplies gained, nobody sick.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Ridge gale
events.body: A gale sweeps the ridge line and tears at the tents. The next shelter is a day's march off.

choices.label: Shelter below
choices.preview: Days lost, supplies unharmed.

choices.label: Cross the ridge
choices.preview: Supplies lost to the wind, with a shown chance explorers may be lost.

events.title: Lost trail
events.body: The trail markers end at a dry streambed. Both paths lead on, and the map shows neither.

choices.label: Scout both paths
choices.preview: Days lost and a new region revealed.

choices.label: Pick a path
choices.preview: No delay, with a shown chance of a wasted march that costs days and supplies.

events.title: Traders at the ford
events.body: Traders wait at the ford with grain and hand-drawn maps. They are willing to deal.

choices.label: Buy a map
choices.preview: Supplies spent, a new region revealed.

choices.label: Buy grain
choices.preview: Days lost haggling, supplies gained.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.preview: Nothing gained, nothing lost.

events.title: Herders on the trail
events.body: A large herd fills the trail, watched by herders who keep their hands on their staffs. They want the team to wait or pay.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.preview: Supplies spent, natives left as they are.

choices.label: Wait them out
choices.preview: Days lost, natives left as they are.

choices.label: Drive through
choices.preview: Free, with a shown chance the natives grow angrier that rises with the escort.

events.title: Raiders' camp
events.body: Smoke marks a raiders' camp beside the only pass. Sentries have seen the team, and a runner has gone ahead.

choices.label: Pay tribute
choices.preview: Supplies spent, natives left as they are.

choices.label: Fight through
choices.preview: Free, with a shown chance of a clash that costs explorers and falls with the escort.

choices.label: Go around
choices.preview: Days lost, natives left as they are.
